flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction with NO TriggerConditions.isTableChanged gate and NO singleton flag - evaluated on EVERY required-after trigger check while conditions hold
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Leia occupies a Death Star site (occupy-with: you occupy a Death Star site with Leia there - imprisoned/captive Leia does NOT occupy) AND the Death Star power is 'shut down' (A Power Loss state).

children.req: occupies-with (your presence at location, with actor-filter card there; no spot override, so captive Leia excluded)
global chosen-state flag (Death Star power shut down)

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction with NO isTableChanged gate and NO singleton flag - evaluated on every required-after trigger check
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Leia is not at a Death Star site. Code spot uses only INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE (no INCLUDE_CAPTIVE), so a CAPTURED Leia is unspottable and also flips the card back to front.

children.req: canSpot card at location (active Leia only; captives not spotted)

requirementSemantics: Front flip leaf 1 = OCCUPY-WITH on persona Leia at Filters.Death_Star_site (free, active Leia providing presence; the imprisoned setup Leia cannot satisfy it until rescued).
Front flip leaf 2 = GLOBAL CHOSEN-STATE: isDeathStarPowerShutDown() - a game-state flag toggled by A Power Loss being 'shut down'; not a table-spot at all.
Back flip = CHARACTER-AT-LOCATION ABSENCE: no spottable (active) Leia at a Death Star site; capture, leaving Death Star, or leaving table all flip back to front.

Both sides run a Leia safety net: if Leia is about to leave table for ANY reason, she is instead imprisoned in Detention Block Corridor and cards on her go to Used Pile (front Card215_017.java:154-182; back Card215_017_BACK.java:157-185).
Unusual timing: neither flip trigger is gated on isTableChanged nor marked singleton.

Front + back, once per turn (shared GameTextActionId.RESCUE_THE_PRINCESS_V__DOWNLOAD_SITE): download a Death Star site from Reserve Deck. Card215_017.java:117-136; Card215_017_BACK.java:82-98
Back, once per turn during opponent's draw phase, if opponent initiated no battle this turn: retrieve 1 Force. Card215_017_BACK.java:101-116
otherObligations: Both sides: your Death Star sites generate +1 Force for you; you may not deploy Luke of ability > 4 or [Episode I]/[Episode VII] Jedi. Card215_017.java:107-114; Card215_017_BACK.java:65-73
Both sides: Leia about to leave table -> imprison her in Detention Block Corridor instead (cards on her to owner's Used Pile). Requires Detention Block Corridor on table.

Back (once per turn): if you just 'hit' a character with your blaster, opponent loses 1 Force. Card215_017_BACK.java:207-218
Back: may place Obi-Wan out of play from a Death Star site to cancel a battle just initiated anywhere on Death Star. Card215_017_BACK.java:135-150
Back: I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled (auto-cancel when played and when on table). Card215_017_BACK.java:121-132,187-195
